message: Interaction test fails: cabinet_1 front door hits other_3 while opening. Fix its hinge side, pivot, range or clearance so it can really be used.
Countertop misses several small items visible in the footage: the laminator, digital clock, tape dispenser, stapler, hole punch, and tissue box between other_2 and other_1.
Positioned slightly too far west and south, partially overlapping the view of table_1 and plant_1 at t=22.08s; should be shifted about 0.15 m east and 0.1 m north closer to the window.
Cabinet door handles are rendered vertically near the top of the doors, whereas in the footage they are horizontal black pulls along the top edge of the lower doors.
Locker keypad locks are rendered horizontally instead of vertically along the left side of each locker door.
